correctness.rationale: The prefix-sum energy is unitarily equivalent to ell_2, and the weighted embedding has Hilbert--Schmidt norm squared zeta(2 gamma - 1). The min--max inverse difference form is exact. Tail Neumann bracketing leaves at most one low mode because the fixed-value codimension-one tail satisfies weighted Poincare with constant O(M^(2-2 gamma)); choosing M=R^kappa, kappa>gamma/(gamma-1), makes the tail spectrally irrelevant at threshold R^(2 gamma). Each geometric block is sandwiched between path-Laplacian counting functions with boundary rank error O(log R), giving the phase integral by dominated Riemann sums. Tonelli and beta integration produce the gamma quotient. Finite Sturm and matrix diagnostics passed, and are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Power-decaying Rhaly matrices are a canonical quantitative compactification of Cesaro summation. Their existing boundedness/compactness/Schatten criteria do not determine the optimal approximation error at rank n. The exact gamma-function coefficient, arising from the lattice dispersion 2 sin(theta/2), determines all singular ranks asymptotically, the sharp quasi-Schatten threshold p=1/gamma, and an intrinsic critical logarithmic residue. This is a motivated natural family across all gamma>1, not an isolated numerical slice or a reparametrized known table.
